body:
A table card is a silent staff member that never takes a day off. Café and restaurant table cards put specials, QR links, dessert menus, and house rules exactly where customers are looking, printed on 300gsm art paper or waterproof PVC with a UV protective layer and a folded standing design that stays upright through service. For restaurants, cafés, bars, tea houses, and hotel breakfast rooms, ZprintPro table cards turn every tabletop into a selling point.

F&B operators rotate specials weekly, and a durable standing card makes the swap painless — print once, stand it on every table, and let the QR code drive customers to the live menu or loyalty sign-up. Bars use them for happy-hour boards and cocktail features, while tea houses and cafés place them at the counter for add-on desserts, beans, and merchandise that staff are often too busy to mention.

Hotel breakfast rooms rely on table cards to explain buffet flow, allergen notices, and kitchen hours without adding signage clutter. Because the UV waterproof layer shrugs off coffee rings, juice spills, and daily wipedown, the same card survives weeks of service — which is why venues order in sets and reprint only when the offer actually changes.

Cards print as A6 (105×148mm) or A5 folded, plus custom standing formats, on 300g art paper or 0.5mm waterproof PVC using offset 4-color with a UV waterproof layer. Finishing options include foil, die-cutting, folding, and standing constructions, so the card can echo your brand's typography and palette.

Pricing starts at NT$10–45 per card with a 50-piece minimum, and orders over $99 ship free via DHL 2–4 day global delivery — 3–5 days to the USA and 2–4 days to Japan on the express network, worldwide to 50+ countries. ISO 9001 certified production and a free digital proof keep the loop tight.

**FAQ**

**Q1: Will the cards survive spills and wiping?**
A: The UV waterproof layer protects against coffee rings and juice spills, and the waterproof PVC option is built for heavy daily use.

**Q2: Can I print a QR code for menus or loyalty?**
A: Yes — full four-color printing captures QR codes and menu links crisply, and the finish keeps them scannable for weeks.

**Q3: Which sizes work best?**
A: A6 (105×148mm) and A5 folded are standard, with custom standing formats for signature displays.
